answer: Each identity tends one vine trellis and locks a 70-credit bond. In the ten-minute lantern hour it lights its lantern, whose onyx tag is key-bound to that identity alone. Neighbors log each sighting; the auditor matches serials, spacing, and timestamps. A hired-attendant ring fails: trellises stand 50 meters apart, so one attendant cannot light two lanterns in one window; a reused onyx tag burns the bond. First filing 38 credits; the kth pays 38+6(k-1), the 1000th 6032, and 1000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. An honest agent pays 38 once and reclaims the bond after a clean epoch.
